purpose: Inspect whether the three empirical QSTN profile cards produce interpretable, context-sensitive permission choices before held-out calibration.
scope: A 3 prototype by 3 scenario qualitative diagnostic. It is not a benchmark or a human-likeness claim.
selection_policy: Scenarios are selected only from questionnaire metadata and the request-tool-data semantic relationship. No participant-level response labels are read or used.

scenarios.selection_rationale: A routine request in which listening history directly supports creating a playlist from the user's most-played songs.
A sensitive financial data request that is directly connected to scheduling the requested one-time rent payment.
A sensitive family-contact request that has no apparent relationship to finding movie recommendations.

interpretation_guardrails: Inspect profile differentiation, permission persistence, and response to contextual mismatch descriptively.
Do not compare pilot answers to participant labels or report accuracy, F1, significance, or human-likeness.
Do not treat any individual pilot answer as a pass/fail criterion for a profile card.
Use the audit artifacts to review the exact rendered prompts and raw model responses before any held-out calibration run.
